slice: WS03 S8 Parking (design only; nothing edited). Source of truth: plan row S8 plus Appendix B 4.3, and the existing designs in .plan-work/designs/WS03-durable-loop.md. All paths below are relative to the worktree root; Model Plane paths start with "apps/Model Plane".
summary:
A Do run that hits a typed, content-free, recoverable stop at a round boundary writes an encrypted `park` fold (SaveLoopCheckpoint, kind "park") and returns RunAgentResponse.status "parked". It does not finalize: no terminal receipt, no assistant message, no failure. Parking is an upgrade of a failure, never a new way to fail. Every park-write error (store off, stale seq, size, credential-shaped text, key missing, park_until beyond TTL, park cap) falls back to exactly the pre-S8 outcome.

Mapping:
- CredentialWindow: loop-top `DeadlineCause::Credential` only.
- ProviderExhausted: `subscription_usage_limit`; `rate_limited` only with retry_after_ms; and a new typed inference-core trailer for an unpinned exhausted ladder.
- UpstreamUnavailable: `subscription_upstream_unavailable`.
- ReauthRequired: `subscription_reauth_required`.
- CrashInterrupted: set only by the session-core recovery worker.

Everything else stays a failure: the wall clock, bad_request, prompt_too_long, route_unavailable and route violations, untyped failures, budget exhaustion, ZDR, waived, Space-scoped and depth>0 loops, and parks beyond the cap.

The recovery worker gets fold awareness:
- paused/parked folds, and resuming folds with a live claim, are spared until `updated_at + SESSION_CORE_PARK_TTL_SECONDS`.
- an active fold (or a resuming fold with an expired claim) at the 15-minute deadline is crash-parked, re-sealed under seq+1 so a zombie writer is fenced.
- past the TTL the worker terminalizes through the unchanged `apply_managed_terminal_outcome` as outcome_unknown, which purges the fold in the same transaction.

Wire changes: OrchestrationEvent.RunParked=24 and RunResumed=25, RunAgentResponse.park_reason=11 (new), RunDetail.resumable=17 and park_reason=18, and a raw `run_parked` SSE frame with exactly {run_id, reason, retry_after_ms?, resets_at?}. The SPA gets display-only handling; its Continue button needs S7's park-aware /continue.

HARD DEPENDENCY: S6 (FoldWriter, LoopState::to_fold) and S7 (claim/resume) are not built in this tree. Verified: no fold.rs exists, and the execution-core test double's save_loop_checkpoint returns unimplemented. The execution-core write side of S8 cannot land before S6. Steps 1-3 and 5-6 below are independent of S6/S7.
approach:
DECISION SITES (all in execution-core agent.rs run_rounds, root loop only, depth==0). One helper `try_park` is called at three sites and returns Option<ParkedRun>; None means "fall through to the old outcome".

1. Loop top, `ctx.refusal.latched()` branch (agent.rs ~1310): a run-wide refusal latched by this loop or a child. Only usage_limit and reauth_required latch.
2. Loop top, `ctx.deadline.expired()` branch (~1326): if cause == DeadlineCause::Credential, try park; WallClock always returns OutOfTime exactly as today.
3. The `Err(error)` arm of `inference.infer` (~1438): for a pinned run use `refusal_for_failed_round`; for an unpinned run use the new typed trailer reader. The failed round never produced a response, so the fold records rounds_executed-1 and the unchanged `messages`. The post-loop latched-refusal path and `Exhausted` never park, because no budget is left to resume into.

MAPPING TABLE (`park_reason_for`, pure):
- Credential deadline -> CredentialWindow. NOTE `RunDeadline::for_run` only builds a Credential deadline when guard_credentials is true, today only `route.is_pinned()`. Under EXECUTION_LOOP_PARKING_ENABLED, `run_agent_with_tools` must pass `guard_credentials = route.is_pinned() || (parking_enabled() && parkable_run)`, otherwise unpinned Do runs never reach CredentialWindow. This is a flag-gated behaviour change.
- Refusal.code subscription_usage_limit -> ProviderExhausted (resets_at, retry_after_ms carried).
- rate_limited -> ProviderExhausted only when retry_after_ms is Some; else failure.
- subscription_upstream_unavailable -> UpstreamUnavailable.
- subscription_reauth_required -> ReauthRequired.
- Unpinned run, new inference-core trailer `x-mp-provider-error: provider_chain_exhausted` (AllExhausted arm, grpc.rs:1495, currently an untyped Status::unavailable and the message must never be parsed) -> ProviderExhausted. Unpinned `rate_limited` with retry_after -> ProviderExhausted. Both sit behind the same flag, and the trailer makes this last in order.
- CrashInterrupted: never produced by execution-core.
- Stay failures: WallClock, subscription_bad_request, prompt_too_long, subscription_route_unavailable, RouteUnavailable/route violation, any untyped status, Exhausted, InferFailed(None) on an unpinned run without the trailer.

`parkable()` also requires: !req.zdr, !ctx.route.is_waived(), req.space_id empty (DEC-06: /continue refuses Space runs, so a Space park would be unresumable), session bearer present, rounds_used < max_rounds, parks_so_far < MAX_PARKS_PER_RUN (5). resets_at beyond the TTL is refused by session-core.

PARK FOLD WRITE: LoopFoldV1 {segment_no, counters, step_seq, attempted_retrievals, messages (scrubbed), round_in_flight: None, pending: Some(PendingPause{kind: Park, pause_ref: park_ref}), authority: offered_authority(...), prompt_digest, extensions {"parks": n+1}} -> to_bytes() (credential and size check; one clear_stale_tool_results retry on TooLarge, else no park) -> SaveLoopCheckpoint{kind "park", expected_seq from the FoldWriter, authority_digest, pause_ref = park_ref, park_reason = reason.as_str(), park_until}.

park_ref = "park:{run_id}:{parks}". park_until: Credential/Crash/Reauth = now; Upstream = now + retry_after_ms (default 60 s); ProviderExhausted = resets_at, else now + retry_after_ms, else now + 300 s. park_until is the earliest useful resume time; it does not block /continue and is not the TTL.

RETURN: `RoundsOutcome::Parked(ParkedRun)`. `run_agent_with_route` returns `parked_response(..)` early like Paused: no finalize, no sandbox lease release (same as Paused, so the lease follows its own TTL and a long park may meet WorkspaceStateLost in S7 closers). StateStore RunStatus is left unchanged (it is a per-replica cache; no Parked variant).

response: status "parked", failure_code "", RunAgentResponse.park_reason (new), retry_after_ms (7) and resets_at (8) reused with their doc comments widened.

EMISSION: execution-core publishes OrchestrationEvent.RunParked best-effort through RecordOrchestrationEvent (precedent: publish_plan_transition) after a successful save. The plan's "orchestration_grpc.rs broadcasts from the park/claim handlers" is not implementable as written: SessionGrpc has no events_tx or ReplayBuffer, which are private to OrchestrationGrpc. session-core therefore only adds event_run_id arms. Verified: `grpc::serve` hands events_tx only to OrchestrationGrpc::new_from_env.

The gateway emits the raw `run_parked` SSE frame at the outcome site. `follow_agentic_run` forwards only step updates, so the frame is not duplicated. The separate runs/{id}/events endpoint forwards the orchestration event under the same name and the same keys via orchestration_event_to_sse.

RECOVERY WORKER (terminalization.rs): all fold-awareness is gated on loop_checkpoint::enabled(), so the existing kill switch restores pre-S8 behaviour (terminalize at the deadline, fold purged) and rollback never strands runs. Predicates:
- fold_holds(run) = store on AND fold row where (state IN paused,parked AND updated_at > now-ttl) OR (state=resuming AND claim_expires_at > now).
- fold_expired(run) = store on AND fold row state IN paused,parked AND updated_at <= now-ttl.
- claim_due_recovery candidate adds: NOT fold_holds AND (no pending approval OR fold_expired). This also bounds approvals that never expire (verified: nothing flips expired 'requested' approvals, and has_pending_approval ignores expires_at).
- recover_claimed_terminalization, after lock_run_status and lock_managed_obligation and after the pending-approval check, locks the fold row last (lock order runs -> outbox -> fold, same as save and claim) and calls `decide_hold` (pure): Spare -> release_recovery_for_activity; CrashPark -> park_crashed, then release; Terminalize -> the unchanged apply_managed_terminal_outcome(Failed("outcome_unknown"), reconciliation_required=true).
- park_crashed: decrypt with AAD seq N, set pending=Park and extensions.parks+1, re-seal under seq N+1, UPDATE state parked, kind park, park_reason crash_interrupted, pause_ref park:{run}:{parks}, park_until now, updated_at now. The bump fences a zombie loop (its CAS save fails loop_checkpoint_stale). If parks >= MAX or the cipher is unavailable, it terminalizes as before.
- TTL expiry therefore uses the same single receipt path as the 15-minute deadline: one RUN_TERMINAL event, outbox state reconciliation_required, runs UPDATE guarded by status NOT IN terminal, purge_run in the same transaction. Claim and the worker both lock the runs row FOR UPDATE, so a click racing the TTL either finds the fold purged (loop_checkpoint_not_claimable) or makes the worker see a live resuming claim and spare.

session-core `save` hardening for kind park: park_reason must parse as ParkReason; park_until must be <= now + park_ttl (else failed_precondition park_until_beyond_ttl); the fold's extensions.parks must be <= MAX_PARKS_PER_RUN. record_event payload gains park_reason for the park kind. RunDetail projection: park_reason from fold state parked; resumable = state IN paused,parked OR (resuming AND claim expired). runs.status stays 'running' for a parked run, exactly as it stays for a paused one.

steps: 0. Preconditions: confirm S6 (FoldWriter, LoopState::to_fold, expected_seq tracking, prompt_digest) and S7 (claim/resume) status. Steps 1-3 and 5-6 do not need them; step 4 does. Land the integrator confirmation of RunAgentResponse tag 11 (or take the number it assigns).
1. mp-contracts: ParkReason::as_str/parse/ALL, MAX_PARKS_PER_RUN, PARKS_EXTENSION_KEY, parks_in, golden tests. `cargo test -q -p mp-contracts loop_fold`.

2. Protos and compile-green fan-out in one commit: orchestration.proto 24/25 + messages, execution.proto park_reason=11 + comments, runs.proto 17/18; buf generate for Go; mp-orchestration domain variants and shim arms; session-core event_run_id arms; model-gateway orchestration_event_to_sse / event_payload_value / step_update arms. Cargo one crate at a time.

3. session-core: park_ttl_seconds, save validations, decide_hold + recovery_hold + park_crashed, claim_due_recovery predicates, recover_claimed_terminalization branch, RUN_SELECT/RunDetail projection, record_event park_reason. Write the DB-gated recover_parks tests but do NOT run them without a disposable Postgres and instruction; run the pure ones with `cargo test -p session-core --bins park` and `decide_hold`.

4. execution-core (needs S6): park.rs pure parts + tests first; then the RoundsOutcome::Parked variant, the three try_park sites, run_agent_with_route early return, subagent arm, guard_credentials change, session double changes, agent tests. Flag off must leave every existing agent test untouched.
5. model-gateway: AgenticRunOutcome::Parked, frame builder + arm, run_detail_value fields, tests.

6. SPA: chat-client case + handler, controller wiring, runs-client normalization, run-park.ts, vitest. No Continue button; leave a code comment pointing at S7 and the chat.run.continue contract (extend the contract in the S7 change that makes /continue accept a parked run).

7. Last, optional: inference-core typed trailer for AllExhausted + execution-core unpinned reader + contract test. Ships separately because it widens parking from user-opted subscription runs to every Do run.

8. compose env defaults (false / 86400), ledger addendum. Evidence is S9's job (fake inference-core usage_limit trailer; docker kill execution-core past a shortened deadline). Do not run docker from this task.

Deploy order when it is time: model-gateway + BFF + SPA first (they understand `parked`), then session-core (worker logic is dormant without folds), then execution-core with EXECUTION_LOOP_PARKING_ENABLED last. An older gateway receiving status parked would hit the Unknown arm (RUN_DISPATCH_DEGRADED) while the run is in fact parked.
risks: S6/S7 are absent: S8's write side has no fold writer to call, and a park without S7 is not resumable (the DoD line '/continue after reset resumes' is an S7+S8 joint proof). Mitigation: keep the flag off until both land; S9 live proof covers the joint flow.

Credential-window parking only exists for pinned runs today because RunDeadline::for_run gates the credential guard on route.is_pinned(). Extending it to unpinned runs under the flag changes behaviour (unpinned runs stop starting rounds ~60 s before their earliest bearer expires, ~240 s into a 300 s bearer) and, if the park write then fails, they fail earlier than before. Gate on parking_enabled() and measure round latency before enabling widely.

Park loop / privacy: each park resets updated_at and thus the TTL. Capped by MAX_PARKS_PER_RUN=5 (enforced in execution-core and again in session-core save and park_crashed), so worst case ~5 x TTL of encrypted retention. A usage-limit reset beyond the TTL is refused at save and the run fails with the typed reason as today.

Zombie writer / double execution: a loop that is alive but silent for 15 min could be crash-parked, then resumed by a click while still running. The seq+1 re-seal makes its next CAS save fail (S6 pre_effect saves are fail-closed), but an in-flight tool call can still finish; the ledger sweep already closes reserved rows of parked runs as unknown_outcome and S7 closers must not retry them. Not covered: a tool that completes after the park is recorded completed-without-output, which the closers treat as ResultLost.

Worker re-seal requires the descriptor key in the worker path; if the key is missing the worker terminalizes (pre-S8 behaviour) rather than leaving a half-parked row. Decrypt+encrypt of up to 4 MiB inside a transaction holding the runs/outbox/fold locks; acceptable at crash-park frequency.

Sandbox lease and processes are not released on park (same as Paused). A 24 h park outlives the lease TTL; S7 closers will report WorkspaceStateLost for workspace tools. Not verified how long leases live.

The recovery worker is safety-critical (honest outcomes). Changes are confined to the candidate query and a pre-terminalize branch; the receipt functions are untouched; the kill switch reverts to pre-S8. The candidate query now takes the fold table into account for every due run: confirm with EXPLAIN that (state, updated_at) index and the PK keep it cheap, since the worker polls every second.

Stale pending approvals: today an expired-but-'requested' approval spares a run forever (verified: nothing flips it, and has_pending_approval ignores expires_at). S8's fold_expired clause fixes this only for loop-mode approvals that have a paused fold; cold-mode approvals keep the old behaviour.
Unpinned ProviderExhausted depends on a new inference-core trailer; an older inference-core never sends it and the run simply keeps failing as today (safe). The metrics `outcome` label gains a value.
RunAgentResponse.park_reason = 11 collides with nothing in Appendix B but is not integrator-confirmed; 9 (WS02 usage) and 10 (WS25) are intentionally skipped.

Crash parks emit no live orchestration event (the worker has no events_tx/replay); the UI learns of them from RunDetail.park_reason on reload or poll. A user still staring at a dead stream sees the gateway's existing dispatch-degraded handling.
SPA wording and the closed-token set live in two places (Rust as_str and TS); the golden test pins Rust only, so add a TS table test that fails when a token is added without a label.
invariants: A park is an upgrade of an existing failure: if the park cannot be durably written for ANY reason the outcome is exactly the pre-S8 outcome (same reply, same typed failure_code, same terminal receipt).
Park only on typed, content-free evidence (a closed trailer code, DeadlineCause::Credential, or the worker's own state). Never parse a status message; untyped failures stay failures.
The wall clock (EXECUTION_RUN_WALL_CLOCK_SECS) is an operator cap and never parks.

ZDR, zdr_waived, Space-scoped and depth>0 runs never park. execution-core refuses before calling, and session-core refuses again (run_owner_tx requires retention_class='persistent'; refuse_zdr_continuation).

Parking happens only at a round boundary or at a failed inference round with unchanged messages: round_in_flight is None, rounds_executed excludes the failed round, no effect is ever in flight at the park point.
A park returns before finalize: no terminal receipt, no assistant message, no tool-ledger finalization.

The fold is ciphertext-only (AES-GCM, AAD run/org/user/seq), scrubbed, assert_no_credentials-checked, <=4 MiB; no bearer is persisted or logged; park/event/log fields are closed tokens, counts and timestamps only.
Row columns (pause_ref, park_reason, park_until, state) are authoritative; crash parks re-seal the body under seq+1 so the body, AAD and row agree.

Immutable receipts: exactly one RUN_TERMINAL event and one outbox application per run; TTL expiry uses apply_managed_terminal_outcome(Failed('outcome_unknown'), reconciliation_required=true) unmodified; fold purge happens in the same transaction; crash-park and spare never write terminal state.
Lock order is runs -> outbox -> fold everywhere (save, claim, worker), so claim/TTL races serialize on the runs row.
Kill switch: SESSION_CORE_LOOP_CHECKPOINT_ENABLED off disables all worker fold logic and restores pre-S8 terminalization; parked runs end outcome_unknown, never stranded.
Flag off everywhere is byte-identical to today; the raw run_parked frame keys are exactly {run_id, reason, retry_after_ms?, resets_at?}, with no ChatEvent variant added.
Model proposes, Quarry executes: parking never touches browser_agent or Quarry state; browser_agent is never resumed (S5 closers).
Park never blocks /continue before park_until; park_until is a hint, the TTL is the only expiry.
open_questions: Resume of a park needs claim by pause_ref, but the browser and gateway do not know the ref. Proposal for S7: ClaimLoopCheckpoint accepts an empty pause_ref meaning 'the run's current parked fold' (SQL `(pause_ref = $4 OR ($4 = '' AND state = 'parked'))`, parked only, never paused). Alternative: expose park_ref on RunDetail. Needs an owner call; both are S7 work, and S8 guarantees at most one parked fold per run (PK run_id).

S7's /continue route (continue_preflight, ContinueRunRequest{approval_id, claim_token}) must accept a parked run with no approval, and re-pin a subscription run from the fold: continue_run currently passes AgentRoute::default() and Authority carries provider_hint but not model or subscription_connection_id. Should the park fold store route.model and connection_id in extensions (identifiers, not credentials)? I recommend yes; not verified how S7 intends to rebuild the route.
Should rate_limited park only with retry_after_ms (my design, matching the design doc wording) or always? A short throttle may be better retried by inference-core than parked.
Unpinned ladder exhaustion: ship the inference-core trailer in S8 or defer to a follow-up? Recommend deferring behind the pinned-run parks.
Should crash parks emit a live event (needs the worker to share events_tx/replay with OrchestrationGrpc, or a NATS bridge)? Currently no.
Default park_until when the provider gives no timing (300 s, 60 s) and MAX_PARKS_PER_RUN=5 are my choices, not from the plan.
Extending the credential guard to unpinned runs is a behaviour change under the flag; the plan only says 'S8 parks at the credential margin'. Confirm intent.
Is a user's Cancel on a parked run purged correctly? run_service_grpc.rs:848 calls purge_run (seen), but I did not verify the cancel path ends the managed obligation for a parked run.

Not verified: BFF relay of the raw run_parked frame end to end (inferred from the awaiting_approval precedent and proxy_sse_stream_with_data_plane); whether the BFF ag_ui.rs should list run_parked as CUSTOM (currently falls to RAW, which is safe); that no Go code has an exhaustive switch on the oneof; exact FoldWriter/LoopState signatures from S6; whether execution-core StateStore leaks an entry for a parked run.
